stemMarkdown: In what ratio must a solution containing 31% acid be mixed with a solution containing 54% acid to obtain a mixture that is 47% acid? Give the ratio (cheaper : dearer) in simplest form, e.g. '3:2'.
solutionMarkdown: By alligation: $\dfrac{\text{cheaper}}{\text{dearer}} = \dfrac{y - z}{z - x} = \dfrac{54 - 47}{47 - 31} = \dfrac{7}{16} = 7:16$ (after simplifying by dividing both terms by 1).
